## Annotation and spatial real-data validation is missing

- Source node: `60_Questions/Problems/Annotation-and-spatial-real-data-validation-is-missing.md`; type: `problem`; status: `open`.

Open blocker: annotation and spatial flagship real-data runs are no longer skipped. The first annotation gate was non-selective; a blind successor failed its locked input contract; a separately locked raw-count successor met all endpoints but is explicitly non-blinded to label distributions. The authentic Xenium tiny study failed one locked endpoint. Annotation still requires a new never-seen donor-aware cohort, while spatial requires a full biological public cohort with independent pathology or segmentation truth. Synthetic fixtures remain software-contract evidence only.
